channel.title: Detroit Sports Nation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Detroit Sports Nation (detroitsportsnation.com)

item.title: Carlton Davis Explains What Really Derailed His Return to Detroit
item.description: Carlton Davis wanted to stay in Detroit but explains why contract structure led him to sign with the Patriots instead of re-signing with the Lions.

item.title: Detroit Pistons All-Star to Compete in Slam Dunk Contest
item.description: Detroit Pistons center Jalen Duren is officially taking his talents to one of All-Star Weekend’s biggest stages. According to a report from NBA insider Shams Charania, Duren has accepted an invitation to compete in the 2026 NBA Slam Dunk Contest,…

item.title: Spoiler Alert! Aidan Hutchinson Reveals His NFL Pro Bowl Games Tug-of-War Results
item.description: Detroit Lions star Aidan Hutchinson revealed his team’s tug-of-war results at the 2026 NFL Pro Bowl Games in San Francisco.

item.title: Blockbuster NBA Trade Sends Jaren Jackson Jr. Packing
item.description: The Jaren Jackson Jr. trade to Utah ends Pistons speculation and reinforces that Detroit was never willing to part with All-Star center Jalen Duren.

item.title: Detroit Lions Fan Sues Ford Field, DK Metcalf, Shannon Sharpe, Others
item.description: A Detroit Lions fan has filed a $100 million lawsuit over the DK Metcalf incident at Ford Field, naming the Steelers, stadium management, and media figures.

item.title: Doctor Sounds Alarm on Kerby Joseph’s Long-Term Future
item.description: NFL injury expert Dr. David Chao shared concerning thoughts on Kerby Joseph’s knee, questioning whether the Lions safety can fulfill his contract.

item.title: Detroit Pistons Trade Jaden Ivey, Acquire 2 Players
item.description: The Detroit Pistons have traded Jaden Ivey in a multi-team deal that brings Kevin Huerter and Dario Saric to Detroit as the team reshapes its roster.

item.title: Trade Grade: Detroit Pistons Ship Jaden Ivey to Chicago Bulls
item.description: The Pistons’ trade for Kevin Huerter earns a strong grade as Detroit adds shooting, draft value, and roster clarity at the deadline.

item.title: Los Angeles Clippers Trade James Harden
item.description: A blockbuster NBA trade involving the Clippers and Cavaliers just dropped, featuring a surprising star-for-star swap that could reshape both teams’ futures.

item.title: Riley Greene’s World Baseball Classic Decision Explained
item.description: Detroit Tigers outfielder Riley Greene will sit out the 2026 World Baseball Classic after turning down Team Puerto Rico and not receiving a Team USA invite.
